meta.scope: Pre-registered scientific boundaries for simulation, transfer to human datasets, and conditional SCS validation.
invariants: A simulation label is not subjective human pain.
ECAP measures evoked neural recruitment and is not a direct measure of pain.
Clinical SCS claims require patient-level human ECAP or telemetry linked to a pre-specified clinical outcome.

entities.name: noxious_stimulus
entities.carrier: simulation environment or experimental stimulus apparatus
entities.measurement: commanded location, intensity, duration, and waveform
entities.permitted_conclusion: The applied exposure can be detected or its parameters can be estimated.

entities.name: nociceptive_response
entities.carrier: sensory and downstream neural or physiological system
entities.measurement: neural activity or physiological response after a noxious stimulus
entities.analysis_unit: trial within an animal or participant
entities.permitted_conclusion: A measurable response associated with potentially tissue-damaging stimulation occurred.
entities.prohibited_interpretation: The response is equivalent to subjective pain or chronic pain.

entities.name: protective_behavior
entities.measurement: movement, pose, withdrawal, guarding, or expert behavioral annotation
entities.permitted_conclusion: Observable protective behavior was detected under the defined protocol.
entities.prohibited_interpretation: Behavior alone quantifies subjective pain intensity.

entities.name: self_reported_pain
entities.carrier: human participant able to report experience
entities.measurement: pre-specified NRS, VAS, questionnaire, or ordinal self-report
entities.permitted_conclusion: The model estimates the recorded self-report under the sampled population and protocol.
entities.prohibited_interpretation: The estimate is an objective universal measure of pain or a causal diagnosis.

entities.name: ecap_neural_recruitment
entities.carrier: electrically stimulated and recorded human neural tissue
entities.measurement: artifact-controlled evoked compound action-potential morphology, latency, area, and peak-to-peak amplitude
entities.time_scale: sub-millisecond to tens of milliseconds after a stimulation pulse
entities.analysis_unit: pulse nested in electrode configuration, session, and participant
entities.permitted_conclusion: The signal characterizes evoked neural recruitment and stimulation delivery under the recording configuration.
entities.prohibited_interpretation: ECAP is a direct measure of pain or proves clinical benefit.

entities.name: scs_response
entities.carrier: human patient receiving spinal cord stimulation
entities.measurement: pre-specified patient-level clinical outcome at a fixed follow-up time
entities.permitted_conclusion: The model predicts the defined clinical outcome in an independent patient-level evaluation.
entities.prohibited_interpretation: A waveform-only or within-patient window result establishes therapeutic efficacy or cross-subject prediction.

simulation_domain.neural_scope: Peripheral nociceptors and connectome-addressable ascending nociceptive neurons implicated in rapid escape and sustained avoidance; exact cell/root IDs must be frozen in the simulator manifest for the selected connectome release.
state_variables: neuron activation or spike state when the selected simulator supports it
synaptic input and output state when exposed by the simulator
body pose, joint state, contact state, and locomotor state
environment and stimulus state retained for audit but withheld from a detector when it is the target
stimuli: localized noxious thermal exposure when supported by the selected sensory model
observable_behaviors: locomotor trajectory and pose-derived protective response
simulation_domain.fallback_domain: A separate larval Class-IV multidendritic-nociceptor escape/rolling circuit may be used only as an explicitly different experiment; adult and larval circuits are not pooled.

experiments.name: simulation_stimulus_detection
experiments.input: simulated neural, pose, movement, or behavioral observations without the stimulus command
experiments.output: location, intensity, duration, or presence of a noxious stimulus
experiments.training_data: synthetic individuals and scenarios assigned only to training
experiments.independent_test: held-out synthetic individuals and held-out stimulus scenarios
experiments.success_criterion: pre-registered improvement over chance and leakage controls with confidence intervals
experiments.falsification_criterion: performance collapses after removing the stimulus command or under individual/scenario holdout

experiments.name: simulation_response_estimation
experiments.input: stimulus parameters and pre-stimulus simulation state
experiments.training_data: synthetic individuals and perturbations assigned only to training
experiments.independent_test: held-out individuals, parameter ranges, and perturbations
experiments.success_criterion: response features remain identifiable and calibrated under pre-registered perturbations
experiments.falsification_criterion: the response is not distinguishable from control or is determined by metadata leakage

experiments.name: human_target_transfer
experiments.input: human modalities mapped through modality-specific encoders into an abstract temporal representation
experiments.output: exactly one dataset-specific human target construct
experiments.training_data: human training participants with optional synthetic pretraining performed before human fine-tuning
experiments.independent_test: participant-disjoint validation and at least one compatible independent dataset
experiments.success_criterion: synthetic pretraining improves the pre-selected metric with a 95% confidence interval and no calibration degradation versus human-only and synthetic controls
experiments.falsification_criterion: no gain on participant-disjoint evaluation or gain disappears on a compatible external dataset

experiments.name: clinical_scs_response_prediction
experiments.input: human SCS telemetry or ECAP plus pre-specified clinical covariates
experiments.output: pre-specified patient-level clinical response at a fixed follow-up
experiments.training_data: authorized human SCS cohort, participant-disjoint from evaluation
experiments.independent_test: held-out patients or a separate clinical cohort
experiments.success_criterion: improvement over clinical baseline and a no-synthetic-pretraining model with calibrated uncertainty
experiments.falsification_criterion: no linked outcome dataset, within-patient-only performance, or disappearance under patient-level testing

transfer_chain.input: neural activity, simulation state, movement, pose, and protective behavior
transfer_chain.output: masked temporal embeddings with modality identity and no claim of species equivalence
transfer_chain.success_criterion: representation preserves pre-registered stimulus and response information under perturbation
transfer_chain.falsification_criterion: representation depends on command leakage or fails individual/scenario holdout

transfer_chain.input: synthetic embeddings and dataset-specific human modalities
transfer_chain.output: common temporal interface with explicit modality masks and separate encoders
transfer_chain.training_data: synthetic corpus and human training participants only
transfer_chain.success_criterion: transfer exceeds human-only and naive/random synthetic controls
transfer_chain.falsification_criterion: no comparable observable space or no gain after leakage-safe evaluation

transfer_chain.output: one target construct declared by the selected dataset row
transfer_chain.independent_test: participant-disjoint partition and compatible external dataset
transfer_chain.success_criterion: pre-registered primary metric improves with a 95% confidence interval without worse calibration
transfer_chain.falsification_criterion: effect disappears across participants or requires pooling incompatible targets

transfer_chain.input: a frozen transfer method plus authorized patient-level SCS telemetry or ECAP
transfer_chain.training_data: SCS training patients with linked outcomes
transfer_chain.independent_test: held-out SCS patients or a separate cohort
transfer_chain.success_criterion: incremental patient-level predictive value over clinical and no-pretraining baselines
transfer_chain.falsification_criterion: linked outcomes are unavailable or gain vanishes under patient-level evaluation

ecap_like_observation_model.source_activity: population transmembrane action potentials elicited by electrical stimulation
ecap_like_observation_model.conduction_delays: path-length and fiber-parameter dependent delays applied before summation
ecap_like_observation_model.spatial_summation: signed summation over recruited fibers with distance and orientation weighting
ecap_like_observation_model.electrode_geometry: explicit stimulation and recording contact positions, spacing, polarity, and reference
ecap_like_observation_model.volume_conduction: forward observation operator from neural sources to recording contacts
disturbances: physiological noise including EMG and movement
measurable_characteristics: waveform morphology and classifiability against non-ECAP and artifact waveforms
N1 and later-component latency relative to stimulation
area under the curve and peak-to-peak amplitude
recruitment threshold and response versus amplitude, pulse width, polarity, and contact geometry

tolerance_protocol.reference: participant- and configuration-stratified distributions from held-out human ECAP data
tolerance_protocol.acceptance_rule: Before analysis, register metric-specific bounds from the human training reference only; every required characteristic must fall within its registered 95% reference interval or registered standardized-distance bound on held-out human data.
tolerance_protocol.reason_numeric_bounds_are_null: Raw comparator signals and a locked preprocessing protocol are required; inventing numeric bounds from abstracts would be unsupported.
tolerance_protocol.failure_rule: Failure of any required characteristic keeps the label ECAP-like only and blocks claims of human ECAP equivalence.

ecap_like_observation_model.prohibited_claim: A raw aggregate of simulator activity is an ECAP or a direct measure of pain.

stop_criteria.trigger: The simulator cannot be reproduced from fixed code, configuration, and seed, or target performance is explained by direct access to the stimulus command.
stop_criteria.measurement: independent rerun plus command-removal and leakage-control evaluation
stop_criteria.decision: stop claims for H1 and do not proceed with the affected representation
stop_criteria.reserve_result: release the simulator audit, failure analysis, and a bounded stimulus/response benchmark if reproducible components remain
stop_criteria.forbidden_conclusion: The simulator models pain or provides valid pretraining data.

stop_criteria.trigger: No synthetic observables can be mapped to a documented human modality through a pre-specified representation or modality-specific encoder.
stop_criteria.measurement: completed modality correspondence matrix with all candidate paths marked absent or unjustified
stop_criteria.reserve_result: retain a simulation-method and dataset-generation contribution
stop_criteria.forbidden_conclusion: Cross-species transfer to human pain assessment is supported.

stop_criteria.trigger: Synthetic pretraining does not improve the pre-selected participant-level primary metric over human-only and naive/random synthetic controls, or worsens calibration.
stop_criteria.measurement: participant-level bootstrap confidence interval and calibration comparison on locked independent data
stop_criteria.decision: reject H2 for the tested method and dataset
stop_criteria.reserve_result: report the negative transfer result and conditions under which synthetic pretraining fails
stop_criteria.forbidden_conclusion: FlyBrain-constrained pretraining improves human pain assessment.

stop_criteria.trigger: No legally and ethically available human dataset links SCS telemetry or ECAP to a pre-specified patient-level clinical outcome and follow-up time.
stop_criteria.measurement: documented dataset-access and field audit before the SCS experiment
stop_criteria.decision: do not run or claim clinical SCS-response prediction
stop_criteria.reserve_result: limit the dissertation result to ECAP-like observation modeling and transfer to compatible open human datasets
stop_criteria.forbidden_conclusion: The method predicts clinical response to SCS.

stop_criteria.trigger: Performance exists only for windows from patients seen in training or disappears when patients are held out.
stop_criteria.measurement: patient-disjoint evaluation with participant-level confidence intervals
stop_criteria.forbidden_conclusion: The model predicts SCS response for new patients.

pending_decisions: Author review of the evidence matrix.
Supervisor decision on H1-H3, the reserve scenario, and G0.
Selection of a primary and an independent human dataset after lawful access is confirmed.
Numeric ECAP-like tolerances after raw human comparator access and protocol lock.

meta.rule: Each row has exactly one primary target construct. Datasets with different constructs are not pooled into one metric.

datasets.name: BioVid Heat Pain Database Part A
datasets.license: Academic non-commercial research under a signed institutional agreement; redistribution and public display are restricted by the agreement.
datasets.access_procedure: A permanently employed academic principal investigator signs and submits the Part A-D agreement; students apply through their professor.
datasets.population: 87 healthy human participants in Part A; subject-specific heat thresholds and tolerances
datasets.labels: baseline plus four individualized heat-stimulus levels, 20 samples per class and participant
datasets.permitted_use: Participant-disjoint estimation of protocol-defined experimental heat-stimulus class.
limitations: Access has not yet been exercised by this project.
Stimulus class is not subjective chronic pain.

datasets.name: PainMonit Experimental Dataset
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0; the associated data-use agreement additionally restricts use to academic research.
datasets.access_procedure: Download Figshare version 3 and comply with the accompanying data-use agreement.
datasets.population: 55 healthy human participants exposed to heat stimuli
datasets.labels: objective heater classes with additional perceived-pain information
datasets.permitted_use: Participant-disjoint prediction of the selected pre-declared PMED heater or rating target, never both under one primary metric.
limitations: Heat stimulation differs from naturally occurring pain.
The selected label definition must be locked before analysis.

datasets.name: PainMonit Clinical Dataset
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0; the associated data-use agreement additionally restricts use to academic research.
datasets.access_procedure: Download Figshare version 3 and comply with the accompanying data-use agreement.
datasets.population: 49 physiotherapy participants with arm or neck pain
datasets.labels: timestamped NRS 0-10 ratings and participant-specific no/moderate/severe classes with missing unlabeled intervals
datasets.permitted_use: Participant-disjoint estimation of sparse self-reported pain under the PMCD protocol.
limitations: Self-reports are sparse and weakly label overlapping windows.
No stimulus intensity is available for the clinical procedure.

datasets.name: AI4PAIN Grand Challenge 2024
datasets.license: Challenge data-use terms; no public redistribution license is stated on the checked challenge page.
datasets.access_procedure: Register a team, accept the organizers' terms, and use the supplied train, validation, and held-out test partitions.
datasets.population: 65 human participants in a controlled experimental-pain challenge
datasets.labels: No Pain, Low Pain, and High Pain
datasets.permitted_use: Evaluation on the official 41/12/12 participant train/validation/test protocol.
limitations: Project access has not yet been exercised.
The challenge classes do not establish clinical chronic-pain intensity.

datasets.name: PainMotion Dataset
datasets.license: License recorded on the Zenodo record; verify the downloaded version's license file before use.
datasets.access_procedure: Download the versioned Zenodo record and retain its DOI and license metadata.
datasets.population: 17 healthy participants with DOMS and 6 participants with shoulder musculoskeletal disorders
datasets.labels: binary self-reported pain during industrial tasks
datasets.permitted_use: Participant-disjoint binary self-report modeling in the recorded task context.
limitations: Binary self-report is not a continuous clinical outcome.

datasets.name: EmoPain Database
datasets.license: No open redistribution license confirmed; access is controlled by the dataset owner.
datasets.access_procedure: Contact the UCL dataset owner for the body-movement component and applicable terms.
datasets.labels: protective behavior independently annotated by domain experts
datasets.permitted_use: Participant-disjoint detection of annotated protective behavior.
limitations: Access has not been granted to this project.
Protective behavior is not pain intensity.

datasets.name: ValidPain2 Nociception Level Index
datasets.license: License is distributed with the OpenNeuro BIDS dataset and must be checked for the selected snapshot before use.
datasets.access_procedure: Download the versioned OpenNeuro snapshot ds008115 and preserve its BIDS metadata and DOI.
datasets.population: 180 mechanically ventilated intensive-care patients unable to self-report
datasets.labels: responsiveness around potentially nociceptive clinical procedures
datasets.permitted_use: Participant-disjoint modeling of the defined responsiveness or nociception-monitor target.
limitations: Participants could not provide pain self-report.
The target is not subjective pain intensity.

datasets.name: Chronic neuropathic pain EEG
datasets.license: License is stated on the versioned Mendeley Data record and must be preserved with the download.
datasets.access_procedure: Download version 4 and retain DOI 10.17632/yj52xrfgtz.4 and its terms.
datasets.population: 36 patients with heterogeneous chronic neuropathic pain
datasets.labels: painDETECT and Brief Pain Inventory questionnaire variables
datasets.permitted_use: Within-cohort association or participant-level stratification against a pre-selected questionnaire target.
limitations: Etiology and medication exposure are heterogeneous.

datasets.name: Phantom Limb Pain EEG
datasets.license: The BIDS/OpenNeuro snapshot license must be checked and retained before use.
datasets.access_procedure: Obtain the linked versioned OpenNeuro/NEMAR dataset and preserve DOI 10.18112/openneuro.ds006921.v1.1.1.
datasets.population: 38 participants across phantom-limb-pain, amputee-control, and intact-control groups
datasets.labels: group membership and pain-related phenotype variables
datasets.permitted_use: Participant-level resting-state group comparison using a pre-specified phenotype.
limitations: No published NEMAR data-quality summary was confirmed in the source audit.

compatibility_rules.condition: Targets must be harmonized as protocol-defined experimental classes; modality-specific encoders and participant-disjoint splits remain mandatory.
A common metric is allowed only after a single compatible self-report definition, scale transform, time reference, and population scope are pre-registered; otherwise evaluate separately.
Behavioral annotation remains a separate endpoint.
Responsiveness to a potentially nociceptive procedure remains separate from self-reported pain.
Resting-state group phenotype remains separate from evoked experimental and self-report targets.
